gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests that a {@link BoundedReader} wrapped in a {@link LineNumberReader} can read a file to the end without hanging, when that file's content ends with an end-o
ADDED i2: Fails the test if reading the file does not finish within this duration (guards against an infinite loop).
ADDED i3: Three lines, where the final line is terminated by an end-of-line character.
ADDED i4: A character limit far larger than the test content, so the bound never truncates the data.
ADDED i5: Writes the given text to a temporary file, then reads every line of it back through a {@code LineNumberReader(BoundedReader(...))} until end-of-file. @param dat
ADDED i6: Reads and discards every line available from the given reader, after wrapping it in a {@link BoundedReader}. @param source the reader to drain. @throws IOExcept
